title: "7800 BIOS row: Off by default, On with a checked file"
phase: 14
area: platform
type: feature
size: S
depends_on: [163-platform-a7800]
---

## Why
ProSystem loads `7800 BIOS (U).rom` (or `(E)` for a PAL cart) from the system dir whenever it is there; there is no option. With it, a signed game shows the logo for about 2 seconds and an unsigned cart never draws (tested). Off is the better default; On is for those who want the logo.

## Scope
- [ ] A7800 Screen row **BIOS: Off / On**, default Off.
- [ ] Off: open ProSystem with an empty system dir (`Saves/A7800/system`) so it cannot find the file. On: `BIOS/` as today.
- [ ] On with a missing or wrong file (U: 4096 bytes, md5 `0763f1ffb006ddbe32e52d497ee848ae`; E: 16384 bytes, md5 `397bb566584be7b9764e7a68974c4263`): toast, boot as Off.
- [ ] slot never ships, fetches or names a source for the BIOS.

## Tests
| ID | File | Asserts |
|---|---|---|
| (done) | `atari_core.rs` | with `SLOT_7800_BIOS` an unsigned cart never draws; else a BIOS skip |
| (new) | `a7800_bios.rs` | Off hides the file from the core; On with a short file toasts and boots Off |

## Edge cases
| Case | Expected handling |
|---|---|
| A 0-byte placeholder of the right name | Counts as missing |
| PAL cart with only the (U) file | The core looks for (E): treated as missing |

## Acceptance
- [ ] `task check` green.

Part of issue 170: both settings on a real game.
